Title: Acanthus Moon - Gold Finish
Description:
Sweeping leaf forms turn a familiar botanical motif into a clean, flowing relief. Raised curves and quiet recesses let light and shadow become part of the composition.

Think sunlit courtyard walls and the graceful lines of classical foliage, translated into a piece that feels at home in a modern space.

A gold-toned finish adds warmth and catches the changing light.

  • Material: Made from a gypsum-based material.
  • Surface effect: A decorative surface effect is applied to create the finish shown.
  • Dimensions: 50 × 30 × 6 cm
  • Weight: Approximately 8 kg
  • Use: Suitable for outdoor use and indoor display.
  • Fixings: Keyhole fixings are usually used. Other options, including French cleats, are available; the fixing choice can be agreed for your sculpture and wall.
  • Availability: Made to order
  • Production lead time: 1–2 weeks
  • Delivery: Delivery is quoted separately. Please contact us for UK and international delivery options.

Room settings and group arrangements are illustrative; this listing is for the individual sculpture described above.
